cross_lane_disposition.statement: scripts/ods-controller.ts:50-72 defines IMMUTABLE_BY_CONVENTION as an EXACT-membership closed world (:49 — 'EXACT membership — never a subset test') enumerating ODS addenda v1.0.1 through v1.0.11. It does not contain v1.0.12. tests/ods/ods-controller.test.ts:92-93 asserts length 22 as a HARDCODED constant and performs zero filesystem reads, so creating v1.0.12 fails no test today. The obligation is nevertheless mandatory: until v1.0.12 is enumerated, the Controller would not classify a write targeting it as PROTECTED_SURFACE_CHANGE, leaving a silent coverage gap in a guard whose whole value is exact coverage.
exact_minimal_future_surface: scripts/ods-controller.ts — add docs/ops/ods/ODS_V1_MAINTENANCE_ADDENDUM_v1.0.12.json to IMMUTABLE_BY_CONVENTION (22 -> 23) and update the count comment at :49

cross_lane_disposition.why_new_authority_is_required: ODS_V1_MAINTENANCE_ADDENDUM_v1.0.9.json authorized scripts/ods-controller.ts and tests/ods/ods-controller.test.ts 'for the SUCCESSOR mission only', status TO_BE_CREATED. That successor is CLOSED_AUDITED_INTEGRATED at c411e2e, so it is a consumed creation grant, not a standing maintenance grant. ODS_CONTROLLER_AUTHORITY_v1.0.0.json:269 and :271 make the maintenance MANDATORY but grant no write scope to any open mission. The obligation to add v1.0.12 is not itself permission to edit Controller code.
cross_lane_disposition.merge_order: PR #56 MAY merge before the Controller maintenance, provided the maintenance follows immediately under that new authority. The ordering is forced: the maintenance enumerates an artifact that exists only on this branch, and the Controller test performs zero filesystem reads, so an earlier edit would assert coverage of an artifact absent from the tree. The interval in which v1.0.12 exists in integration while the guard still ends at v1.0.11 is an ACCEPTABLE governed transitional state — bounded, CI-green, no runtime effect, CONTROLLER_DB_EXECUTION=DISABLED, and precedented by v1.0.10 and v1.0.11.
cross_lane_disposition.prohibition: The immutable closed-world guard MUST NOT be weakened, and must never be relaxed into a subset test, prefix match or directory sweep to absorb future addenda automatically.
